summary: A 1938 L-4 cab built for Sawtooth National Forest fire watch, used in emergencies into the 1970s, now locked and abandoned at the end of a hike-in trail.

access.note: Reached on foot by a hike-in trail. The cabin is locked and visitors cannot enter the building.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in from the Horton Trailhead. Discover Sawtooth gives a 7.2-mile round trip with 2,600 ft of gain; a 2004 visit report describes a three-mile hike.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 9,777 ft (2,980 m), which matches the brief's elevation_m. firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 9,900 ft. Both figures are reported in the story.
A 2004 visit report says three-mile hike access. Discover Sawtooth gives a 7.2-mile round trip, about 3.6 miles each way. The story reports the difference rather than choosing one.

notes_for_editor: Built year (1938) and L-4 design agree across three sites. The 1939 newspaper item calls the lookout newly constructed, which fits 1938 but reaches us only through the weebly page. Status (standing, abandoned) and access rest on a 2004 NHLR visit report and undated summary pages; no 2025 or 2026 visit was found, so re-check before publication. Staffing as_of is the read date because Discover Sawtooth is undated. No staffing history after 1960 was found beyond 'into the 1970s'. The brief's access value 'unknown' is replaced with restricted. No corrections to the brief's record.
